## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**

## Walkthrough

This PR introduces two independent changes: (1) CI/CD and test runner infrastructure to execute locally-committed test vectors from the `test-vectors-local/` directory alongside externally-sourced vectors, with conditional checkout of the external `fluffylabs/test-vectors` repository; and (2) a state safety fix that prevents retrieval of potentially stale service information for services removed in the current state update round.

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes
